[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-18d[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Reliable Agents-tab x kill and dismiss[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Pressing `x` on any Agents-tab node (agent, clan container, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]workflow, monitor, proc shell, gate, panel, group, or marked set) [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]removes every affected row at once and it never comes back. Every [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]process that belongs to a killed node is verifiably terminated, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]including descendants that left the runner's process group. This [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]holds even if the TUI exits right after the keypress.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rust cleanup wire for live runners and atomic dismissed index[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core-wire[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-wire: in sase-core, add runner_is_live to the cleanup target wire [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](schema 5) so a FAILED row with a live runner becomes a kill item. Add [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]an atomic, locked, merge-on-write dismissed-index update API. Then [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]update the Python wire, the reference planner, the target projection, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and the sase-core revision pin in the same change.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Session removal tombstones honored at every roster publication[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]row-tombstones[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]row-tombstones: record a session tombstone for every x-driven removal. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Honor it in the load compute filter, the Tier-1 merge, apply time [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](removal-generation recheck), fleet reprojection, and refilter, ahead of[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]runner_is_live. Keep the local roster copy in sync, fix the revive-modal[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]repair that drops kill identities, and stop one failed signal from [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]blocking the removal of every other row.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Verified process-tree termination in the durable cleanup proc[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]tree-kill[dim] · [dim][/dim]after row-tombstones[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]tree-kill: add a shared terminator that finds an agent's whole process [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]set (process group, session, ppid tree, and inherited launch scratch [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]key). It sends SIGTERM, escalates to SIGKILL, and verifies death. The [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]durable persist-cleanup proc runs it before it releases workspaces or [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]deletes artifacts. The TUI only sends the immediate SIGTERM. Also stop [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the in-flight guard from dropping whole batches.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]x stops every member kind instead of skipping it[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]member-scope[dim] · [dim][/dim]after row-tombstones, tree-kill[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]member-scope: focused x on a running monitor, an active proc shell, or a[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pending gate now stops or cancels it and removes the row in one step. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Clan, panel, group, and marked cleanups include active proc shells and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pending gates instead of skipping them. Leftover members are named [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]explicitly, and remote clan members are resolved correctly.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Additive dismissed-index persistence for every writer[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]additive-dismissals[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-wire, member-scope[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]additive-dismissals: switch the cleanup transactions and every other [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dismissed-agents writer from full-snapshot saves to the core-wire [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]add/remove API. Revive becomes a removal. Concurrent procs, runners, and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]TUIs can no longer lose each other's dismissals.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]End-to-end x regression coverage[/bold #D7AFFF]                              [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]e2e-regression[dim] · [dim][/dim]after additive-dismissals[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]e2e-regression: drive the real Agents tab through Textual pilot against [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]on-disk fixture agents with real process trees. Race an in-flight load, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a fleet reprojection, and a live runner against x on a clan and on [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]single rows. Assert the rows never reappear and every fixture process is[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dead.[/#D7D7AF]
